description: Camera doesn't load, game not playable
Walk animation too rapid, guns laggy and heavy
Map and enemy clipping, whole-map flicker
Own shoulder inside the first-person camera
Rifle swings ~90 deg during reloads, also while walking
FOV looks wrong on a wide screen
Edges look sharp/aliased (TAA over-sharpened)
Player became 'the default strange rig'
Main menu gone
Gun hold and ADS broken, reload worse
3D blood drops fly onto the screen
Headless enemy in a screenshot
Music dips during fights and comes back late
Standalone build crashes after shader warm-up
Game skips the main menu
Hidden test runs play game audio in the background
QA check Reload.WalkingNoFlip passes while the rifle stands vertical
Tactical chat NullReferenceException in every gameplay scene
CTF flag zones look awful
Two compile errors in-flight (missing using, private killcam fields)
Laser colour set on a property HDRP Unlit ignores
QA hands-on-gun check reads IK error; foot slide not plant-gated
Fire damage stacks per hitbox collider; particles lack an HDRP material; light too dim
Font research recommends the fonts already in use
Pose-check edit left a broken string literal for one minute
Deprecated FindObjectsByType overload in new CameraShake
Weapon hold / fingers still look wrong
Unity compile error reached the developer: Recorder.valid (PerformanceFrameTelemetry, P3 telemetry); Copilot also saw it in its own run at 00:08
Unity compile error reached the developer: HDAdditionalLightData.displayLightIntensity (FireHazard fix) does not exist in HDRP 17.5
RetargetProxy finger-mode edit captured a ref parameter in a local function: file uncompilable for ~30 s
AtmosphereFX lacks the low Local Volumetric Fog layer from the B40 spec
Agents saved scripts during another agent's Unity run; mid-run recompile killed pose check #4 (process defect)
LR2GlassMaterials.Build called tex.Apply(false, true) before EncodeToPNG causing ArgumentException on T_LR2_Glass_Grime/Cracks
B53 spec claims 125 ms target-velocity lag, anisotropic flick errors, and HTML component/nav/miss panels but none are present in BotController.cs or bot-brain.html
B54 asset catalog contains non-reproducible or inaccurate paths: Holosight root/prefab casing, Humanoid sliding clip missing UnarmedSet, and absent AK-74 HDRP cache package
Visible pose check reports walking stance foot slide at 2.38 m/s, exceeding the 0.5 m/s acceptance threshold
Visible AK-12 tactical reload reports charge displacement 0.021 m, exceeding the <0.02 m acceptance target
Visible MK18 hand close-up loses the weapon and is dominated by the torso, so the per-gun grip/pose evidence is not acceptable

Static review: tail-router reservation is not released when LR2Audio voice allocation returns null; the slot remains occupied until expected clip expiry and may suppress later tails under pool saturation
User reports MK18 reload is badly broken while walking or sprinting and the gun jumps at the end of the reload
User reports weapon and hand animation can remain badly misaligned after death/respawn until sprint, fire or reload input
ReloadMotionBridge.WeaponBoneOverlap set to 1: reload gun motion became 0 deg (pose check 04:14)
Pose-check A/B set WeaponBoneOverlap=1 and never restored it, so after the default became 0 (04:19) every later reload measurement (empty, walking) ran on the non-default setting

Pose-check probe measured the hidden duplicate MK18 Mag/Bolt under the inactive Mk18_Core_Unused, so magMaxDisp/chargeMaxDisp read 0.000 m and B68 ("mag never moves") was a false alarm (fixed probe: mag 0.428 m, bolt 0.090 m)

Killcam does not look like the player view (user priority 04:10); pose check C9 root causes: lens 10 cm above the driver eye socket, killer head copied visible, synthetic gun/camera kick on top of the recorded real recoil, victim sinks below the floor, dead-victim low-health grade in the replay
Killcam victim collapse moves the puppet 0.82 m down: at the end of the replay the victim has sunk below the floor and only the dropped gun floats (pose check C9 kc_08)
Killcam lens placed at the SWAT skull eye estimate (VisualEyePosition) instead of the driver eye socket: 10.2 cm too high, so the ADS sight picture became a hip-fire view (C9 probes kc_00a vs kc_00b)
Dead victim's low-health vignette/desaturation (CombatPostFX) graded the whole killcam replay

HeatHazeEmitter.Awake throws NullReferenceException whenever a gun is copied (dropped weapon at death, killcam puppets): the copy already has the MeshFilter it adds, so AddComponent returns null (pose check C10)
W_Mk18_ReloadEmpty.anim opens the bolt (0.090 m) at frame t=0 even during tactical reloads + LR2QABotRunner.FindChildNamed read inactive Mk18_Core_Unused + CameraShake.Response raced equipTime
SM_Lantern_01 floated ~0.30 m above SM_Crate_01 in LR2_MainMenu_vis.png + BuildMenuScene threw NRE on null _rnd standalone + LR2ReadmeMediaRunner missed EnteredPlayMode across domain reload
HDRP dynamicResolutionSettings.advancedUpscalerNames containing STP overrode TAAU and FSR 1.0 in HDRenderPipeline.cs:1420 until SyncPipelineAdvancedPriority cleared conflicting entries
PlayerInputSource and AmmoCrate ignored LR2Bindings runtime overrides (menu-only rebinding) and LR2UIBuilder Settings toggle checkboxes rendered white-on-white
HUDController compass banner symbol rendered missing-glyph square tofu box in deadsector_fire_02, foundry_trench_01, and saltworks_fire_02 captures
Direct spawn-to-spawn sightlines exposed 3/16 pairs on Deadsector, 2/16 on Foundry, and 5/9 on TestRange under MapFlowB46 checks before spawn relocation and SpawnBaffles

Death left the animation state of the moment of death: SoldierMovement.ResetState ended a sprint without the sprint-end hooks (Kinemation look 0.80 / stabilisation 0.78 for the whole next life), the re-enabled driver Animator replayed the prone get-up for 3 s (gun rolled 22 deg), and the dropped gun spawned at standing chest height (crouched/prone death: "puts the gun up"). Death test C17

Kinemation layer masks misfire: FullBodyWeight (rifle jog clips ~0.72 + the walk stride sprint blend) switched the view/pose/collision layers to 12 % on every walk and against walls (rifle dropped into a low carry, pistol support hand and look layer masked while moving), and ProneWeight stayed 1 after a prone death (30 deg at the hip, 60 deg in ADS for the whole life: "MK18 goes sideways in ADS"). C17-C20

AK-74N ADS used the hidden 1P29 scope eye point (3.1 cm above and 1.4 cm left of the iron sights): B49 hid the scope but never re-pointed the aim point ("AK74N ADS is totally off, not looking through the iron sights")

Humanoid Kinemation collision layer (the profiles LR2 links): the demo rifle tuck raised the muzzle 85 deg and the job ignores useSecondaryPose, swapping in a 90 deg yaw whenever mouse pitch > 0 (rifle lay sideways across the view at walls, C21-C23 74 deg); the pistol raycast an unused layer

Fire, smoke, mist, barrel smoke/heat glow and heat haze built HDRP/Unlit transparent materials at runtime; player builds strip those variants, so they rendered as opaque quads ("literal not see through boxes"); FireHazard looked for Resources materials that never existed

Bots: gunshot/impact noise positions at muzzle or wall height plus the brain's 1.4 m look offset made searching bots look at the sky; detection took 0.74 s at 20 m on every preset and stress/strafe/movement stacked ~5 deg of aim error, so even Veterans rarely won
Pose-check harness had no guard against the in-game pause menu: an Esc reaching the visible test window set timeScale 0 and froze C16 for 3 min

B26 fix did not put the right hand on the MK18 pistol grip: C10 (09:37) tp_04b/tp_04c show the hand 5-8 cm in front of and below the grip with the index finger straight, grip fully exposed from the right side

Sprint start/end stepped the Kinemation look, stabilisation and playables weights in one frame (1 -> 0.8 / 0.78 / 0.78 and back): about a fifth of the weapon pose snapped at every sprint start and end (C25 sprint-interrupted reload 5.6 deg/frame; C26 2.7 after the fix)

TacticalBotBrain.cs:302-319 dead sprint branch: if (dist > intent.desiredRange * 1.35f || !bb.targetVisible) intercepts every !bb.targetVisible case before the else-if at line 312, making intent.allowSprint = !bb.targetVisible && dist > 9f unreachable (always false), so Hardened/Veteran bots never sprint to press an out-of-sight vulnerable target
Spawns could place a soldier inside props or another soldier: spawn points were used as placed, with no capsule test (user: "sometimes player get inside objects")

Fire smoke still drew boxy squares: the Particle Pack flipbooks are RGB on black with no alpha, and the smoke material alpha-blends (D60 fix incomplete; shader luminance alpha fix pending visual review)
Score limit text flickered between "15" and "FIRST TO 15" (two writers)
ADS while moving: the gun swung up to 9.5 deg (MK18 strafe) and 6.1 deg (MK23 walk) off the sight line; camera bob 6-7 cm (C28)
ADS sight lock moved the weapon after animation evaluation, pulling visible hand IK targets off the gun and making the ADS pose feel forced
Rain streaks appeared inside roofed spaces because camera-following high and near emitters kept spawning particles under ceilings; particle collision cannot stop drops born inside

B57 QA reported close-enemy staging and gunfire gain without staging a hostile target or firing: the runner only measured the normal pose and called NotifyCombatEvent, so defects could pass the live assertions
Commit 9c9bb97 was pushed with a message claiming the fire fix, but the patch script had stopped on a changed shader line (chained commit ran anyway); fixed by ea1f4d0
Bot Lab recoil chart drew the target ~14x too small (px per metre computed as ppd / mpd), so the panels looked empty
In AI vs AI (no local player) bots never got team uniforms: the uniform choice needed a local player
The -lr2AimTest harness no longer engages: the teleport does not hold and the bot never becomes aware (legacy and new aim alike, C32)
A bot arm spun while spectating after the B26 grip iteration 1 build (cause suspected, not confirmed; iteration reverted)
Lobby SKIRMISH title never showed: TMP ellipsis hides a line taller than its box
Headshot-cam capture staged the player invulnerable; bots never target protected players, so the bot never fired
Legacy bot difficulty selector remained on the main menu; moved difficulty selection into the Skirmish roster
Ultrawide startup rendered Skirmish match values blank until a fullscreen toggle; added autosizing and canvas rect/scale refresh
Headshot killcam panned down before the victim collapsed; delayed the camera look-target pan until later in the fall
All weapons pitch upward and then rotate/spin continuously. User suspects recent finger changes, but cause is unconfirmed; inspect and revert/correct the responsible edit, then verify every weapon.

Root cause of D83 (bots): shared IK-motion assets (stop, crouch, lean, jump, equip, unequip) evaluated by Kinemation inside parallel animation jobs; AnimationCurve is not thread-safe, so a soldier occasionally read a garbage angle and its gun turned 60-180 deg for one frame. Fixed with per-soldier motion copies; A/B spikes 7/23 -> 0/0.

Root cause of D83 (bots, when hit): HitReactions bent the hidden driver chest/head after RetargetProxy copied the pose, so the gun (child of the driver head) swung up to ~70 deg off the hands and the visible body never flinched. Frames > 60 deg 286 -> 28.

Root cause of D83 (player): the Kinemation wall tuck ran at full strength in ADS (pivot at the eye), swinging the rifle 23 deg across the sight line; since the 11-18 tuck retune and walking no longer masking the layer. Gated by ADS weight: 22.8 -> 3.4 deg.

LR2 after-animation gun edits (eye-plane push, flip guard, reload bridge, prone tuck) were read back by Kinemation ADS next frame (aim point from transforms); bot eye-plane push reached 8.2 m. Gun reset before FPSAnimator.Update.
Killcam replay drew every soldier's recorded shots (and the victim's own) as tracers from the killer's muzzle; with several bots the rounds flew in their shooters' directions
Live match tracers and impacts, and the hidden live killer's laser (re-enabled every frame), were drawn into the killcam replay: nothing gated them while it played
The killing round and the killer's post-kill rounds never replayed: ShotFired is raised after Killed and the replay list was built in OnKilled
Lobby left/right stepper buttons rendered empty: the heading font has no "<" and ">" glyphs
CALLSIGN field had no caret or selection highlight: TMP_DefaultControls.CreateInputField enables the field before its text component exists
Committed LR2ContentBuilder.TuneHumanoidCollision had the B125 AimingWeight block outside the loop that declares col (editor compile error in HEAD); the fix stayed unstaged next to an unrelated hunk
Tracer visibility QA treats an absent or unreadable texture as UV-pass, so the head/tail alpha regression can escape review
SWAT menu hero QA checks the skull-mask material and hidden driver but does not require an enabled SWAT renderer
No death sound and fake-sounding pain/breathing groans after B136 robot prefab switch (PainVoice was never attached to player/bot prefabs)
Loading screen overlapping text and dual-panel bleed-through (MainMenuController loadingPanel + LR2LoadingIntro vertical collision)
Grenade throw playing an emote (AA_CallEmote) instead of a throw clip on demo rifles
Killcam header used faux-bold LiberationSans SDF instead of UITheme fonts
Q/E lean polarity inverted, bottom-right weaponName overlapped magText, gun blood spawned below barrel, reload audio out of sync, and PiP scopes used square crosshair quads
MainMenuController.BuildSkirmishLobby cleared SkirmishSetup.Active=false on Start, collapsing 4v4 AI bench runs into 1v1 + idle P1
HDRI sky zenith pinch artifact, missing multi-layer volumetric clouds, and dark Saltworks courtyard lighting floor
Reload cutoff truncated slightly before magazine visibly seated, and flying props appeared in Saltworks corners
Grenade mesh throw timed out of sync with hand release, explosion lacked fiery scale, and indoor rain vanished outside doorways
Killcam enemy weapon and hands desynced during replay playback (weapon followed one transform path while hands followed another)
Suppressed MK18 shot SFX sounded too faint without layered crisp suppressed fire punch
ADS sight-line lock (WeaponAntiClip, order 520) moved the gun after Kinemation solved the arms: hands loose on the gun
LR2AdsAudit passed by construction: it required the lock to have run and measured the aim after the lock forced it to zero
Kinemation core edited in 9 files (git-ignored, unreviewed); 8 of them changed vendor behaviour LR2 did not need
Visible left thumb stood up over the handguard and into the iron sight: T-pose rotation copy of a differently rested, larger Mixamo hand
FAL 'iron sights' showed the sight-less scoped mesh (source FBX path pointed at the wrong folder, silent fallback)
MK18 iron sight had no rear sight (it lives inside the ACOG attachment)
Iron-sight eye points too low (MK18 -2.8 mm, FAL -1.8 mm, AK-74N -2.2 mm vs Kinemation): looking over the hand into the bottom of the rear sight
Shots used the previous frame's aim direction and origin (up to ~10 deg on a 600 deg/s flick)
ADS optic came 2-5 cm behind the eye while firing: Kinemation demo recoil push (5 cm/shot) with LR2's camera-on-sight ADS
Skirmish START called AbortSession, which always loads the main menu: menu reload queued in the same frame as the map load
Telemetry save could soft-lock the end-of-match screen when the output folder cannot be created
Quitting an experiment mid-match said DATA SAVED while that match was never recorded
Every non-player shooter had 16 % recoil climb and 20 % view kick (hard-coded): near-laser bot sprays, biased human-likeness data
GroqClient.Busy stayed true forever when a scene change killed the request coroutine: LLM bots silently became rule bots
LLM study log cut every reply to 140 chars, biasing the order statistics in LLM_BOT_STUDY
DATA_COLUMNS documented err_pitch with the wrong sign (code: > 0 = above the target)
gpt-oss calls failed JSON validation on 45 of 92 bench calls (reasoning used up max_tokens; no reasoning_effort)
Tracers trailed a strafing shooter: fixed world path from the shot-time muzzle at 280 m/s
In ADS strafing the sight swung 17-47 px while shots went to the screen centre, and shots left from last frame's eye position

ADS reached the sight at 1.4-1.8x its own ADS time (AK-12 339 ms for 0.21 s) and settled even later: Kinemation's sine curve started slowly and the aiming IK motion, played 2.2x longer than the ADS, kept the sight swinging 10-17 px after the gun arrived
In ADS, releasing the movement keys played the 1.2 s stop lurch (up to 9 deg roll), replacing the aiming motion: the sight sat 50-65 px off for half a second after a sprint

First version of the ADS speed fix used one ease-out curve for Kinemation's ADS weight in both directions: ADS-out left the sight slowly and hit the hip at full speed while the zoom was already 90 % out
New ADS timing test started trials right after a 180 deg turn: Kinemation's turn layer slid the camera ~6 cm during the ADS, which read as a slow pistol ADS (442 vs 92 ms)
Dying while aiming freezes Kinemation's ADS weight (FPSAnimator disabled on death, profile not relinked on respawn): the respawned soldier's gun starts at the sight and drops within its ADS time
